scenes.ovoz: In just three days, one of the most anticipated games in history finally arrives.
Grand Theft Auto Six. Here is everything confirmed so far.
The last main game, GTA Five, came out in 2013. That is a gap of thirteen years, the longest in the series.
When the first trailer dropped in December 2023, it pulled more than ninety million views in twenty-four hours. That is a Guinness World Record for a video game reveal.
It was first promised for 2025. In May 2025, Rockstar delayed it to May twenty-sixth, 2026. Then in November 2025, it slipped again, to November nineteenth, 2026.
It launches on PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X and S. A PC version has not been announced.
The standard edition costs seventy-nine ninety-nine, and the Ultimate Edition ninety-nine ninety-nine. Boxed copies contain a download code, not a disc.
The story is set in Leonida, Rockstar's take on Florida, home to a modern Vice City. You play as Jason and Lucia, the first female lead in a main GTA game.
Digital preloads opened on November twelfth. At launch, it is single-player only. Online comes later.
GTA Five has sold around two hundred thirty-five million copies. Can Six beat it? Tell us in the comments, and subscribe for more.
